question: Give the number of votes for the post about data visualization.
evidence: About data visualization is the Title that contains 'data visualization';
clarification: Count each distinct Id only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.Title LIKE '%data visualization%'
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.Title LIKE '%data visualization%'

b.request: Count the distinct vote Ids (COUNT(DISTINCT votes.Id)) in the votes table for posts whose Title contains 'data visualization'
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.Id) FROM votes v JOIN posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id WHERE p.Title LIKE '%data visualization%'
